summary: Iteration 17 — PO/Surat Perintah Vendor multi-item refactor verified end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest passing covering POST validations, cost auto-creation rules (both awb_id & harga>0 required), PATCH update flows (add/remove/change), DELETE cascade, and serialize() regression on invoices/costs/orders/panjar. Frontend: WA button generates correct wa.me/?text= URL with Indonesian 'SCHEDULE PICK UP TGL …' template, Buat PO modal has multi-item dynamic rows with all required fields, save → list refresh works, expand→edit modal works with pre-filled values.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 6469 lines — should be split into modular files (po.py, costs.py, accounting.py, etc.) per the >700 line guideline.
_process_po_item_cost swallows post_journal HTTPException silently with bare except. Consider logging the error so a journal posting failure can be diagnosed.

PATCH update_po_item: when AWB-only or harga-only changes (e.g., user just updates armada description), the same_awb/same_amt comparison still passes and cost is preserved — good. But when ObjectId equality is compared (cost.get('awb_id') == new_item['awb_id']), both are ObjectId so OK; tested fine.

DELETE /api/purchase-orders raises HTTP 400 with 'Cost terkait sudah disettle' inside loop AFTER potentially deleting earlier costs (loop order non-deterministic). Should pre-check ALL linked costs for settled state before any deletion to avoid partial cascade.
Frontend buildWAText uses toLocaleDateString('id-ID') — relies on browser locale; works in tested env but could be unreliable on other devices.
seed_data_creation: Test PO docs (TEST_E2E_*, TEST_PO_*, TEST_PATCH_V, TEST_DEL_V) created during tests; each test cleans up via DELETE after assertion. A few from UI test (TEST_E2E_<timestamp>) remain in DB — safe to ignore or purge by prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PO refactor stable. New schema items[] with origin/destination/armada/item_description/qty/harga/awb_id. Cost auto-created only when BOTH awb_id and harga>0. PATCH endpoint /api/purchase-orders/{pid}/items/{idx} handles update + cost reconciliation. WA button uses window.open to wa.me/?text= (no phone). For UI tests on this app, login inputs have no name/type='text'; use generic input[] query selector and fill by index. Public URL: https://git-tweak-staging.preview.emergentagent.com/arc/...
